AdminServlet
Handles all admin portal requests under /admin/*.
AppContextListener
Initializes the DataStore when the application starts.
Application
Represents a TA's application for a job posting.
AuthFilter
Servlet filter that enforces authentication and role-based access control.
BaseServlet
Abstract base class for the role-specific servlets (TA, MO, Admin).
DataStore
Singleton in-memory data store with JSON file persistence.
GeminiService
Calls the Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API to analyse how well a TA's CV matches a job's requirements, with workload penalty and competition-aware redirection logic built into the prompt.
Job
Represents a TA job posting created by a Module Organiser (MO).
